crosswalks.label: Financial Risk Specialists
crosswalks.rationale: Financial Risk Specialists is a bounded occupational baseline for Risk Manager; AXM profession identity/authority/maturity remain separate.

findings.summary: Risk Management must keep risk models/scores, specialist evidence and authorized risk acceptance as separate layers.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make score-versus-truth, cross-domain aggregation and risk-acceptance-owner boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Risk Manager reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent institutional authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No role label, package, model capability, repository permission or coordination function creates constitutional, product, professional or institutional authority.
